name: Venge Of Mari 1.1
author: Dileriuml
description:
## Intro
There was this little girl. Mari. She died in assault of Mariupol. But she got a second chance, resurrected as powerful machine and is ready to annihilate everyone on her way! Сhannel her anger, but be careful: don't waste her second chance!

## Controls
WASD - move,
Space - jump,
LeftMouseButton - attack

## Note
Attacks works every way except bottom (unlockable at npc for souls), use WASD+LMB(left mouse button). Animation for that is broken, we hadn't time to make it properly - it will be fixed soon.

## Theme
**Every 10 seconds** made in affix mechanics:
There are 2 sequences of spawning things:

Rocket volley, Mines and Airborne soldiers for *cycle of danger*

Boxes and Hp drops as *help cycle*

They work at the same time with slight delay.
